$description: ContextualHelp (platform/components/ContextualHelp, library wave 5, lane A): its component tokens. The info button is a ghost Button of the inline-action role and the popover is Popover's; these are the inline tip and the link's spacing.

contextual-help-link-margin-block-start.$description: ContextualHelp: the space between the explanation and its link in the popover.

contextual-help-inline-text.$description: Inline tip: the text color (muted, as helper text).

contextual-help-inline-icon-color.$description: Inline tip: the info icon's color.

contextual-help-inline-gap.$description: Inline tip: the gap between the icon and the text.

contextual-help-inline-font-size.$description: Inline tip: the text size (the helper text size).

contextual-help-inline-line-height.$description: Inline tip: one text line, 20px; the icon's box is one line tall, so the icon centers on the first line.
